config.label: main-study
notes: The design is 2 strategies x 4 payload stages = 8 cells at 30 repetitions, 240 runs. full is
the cold migration of the whole work/ export. manifest sends work/ without node_modules and the
target runs npm ci --no-audit --no-fund between unpack and restart, measured as install_ms.
small is a control cell: without dependencies cold and manifest coincide, so it measures the
platform base and stays out of the crossover point.
light carries express, chosen by npm ci duration: of the ~1 MB candidates it installs slowest
(625ms against 370ms for moment, locally), so a crossover above it is not a chosen result.
Every stage installs with npm ci against a lockfile in browser/src/lockfiles/, resolved with
--before=2026-09-28T19:50:00Z, so medium and large keep the bytes of the 90 cold runs of 28.09.
medium carries @babel/preset-env: a file count close to large (3129 against 2922 files), so
the stages differ mainly in bytes. 135 packages against 45 matter once install is measured.
The logging interval is fixed at 1000ms and is no longer an axis. Its effect on state loss is
mechanical (the per-cell median is interval/200 ticks at a uniformly drawn stop offset), and its
apparent effect on time did not survive the pilot: it was confounded with the position in the
cycle and with E2B's bimodal dispatch latency.
Cells are shuffled per cycle: with a fixed order every cell ran at the same position in every
cycle, so the position was indistinguishable from the cell.
repeats=30. At n=10 the median difference between two cells lay within the spread, and a single
E2B outlier shifted the median of a cell. The dispatch latency is bimodal (96 against 518 ms).
No run is discarded: first_run and position_in_cycle let the analysis compute with and without.
seed determines stop offsets and permutation from separate streams, so changing the order does
not shift the drawn offsets.
seed rule, fixed before the search: the first seed from 20260910 upward whose 8-cell dry-run plan
has every cell at every position at least once. Tried 20260910 (1 cell misses a position),
20260911 (2), 20260912 (1), 20260913 (0). A randomization test has to apply the same restriction.
Before the full run: --repeats 1 as an acceptance check against E2B (restore_dispatch_ms
populated, client_clock_skew_ms independent of the payload size, position_in_cycle set,
host_stall_ms present).
Rule out a host suspend beforehand. Three runs of the pilot stood still for 936s, 929s and 149s,
without runTimeoutMs taking effect.

env_info.target_node_version_note: read from adapter.create() of the target environment
env_info.node_version_note: Source and target deliberately run on different Node versions: the E2B default template is fixed to v20.x and cannot be changed without a custom template, the source follows the devcontainer image. node_version_aligned compares process.version with target_node_version by major version, once both are known. See README, section "Limits of the measurement".
env_info.target_tooling_note: unzip and node as resolved inside the target on the first adapter.create(). Evidence that the image brought them: installing a missing tool per run would land inside a measured phase.
env_info.e2b_region_note: not determinable: SandboxInfo from the e2b SDK (as of e2b@2.38.3) contains no region field
env_info.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
env_info.browser_note: taken from the X-User-Agent header of the first POST /run
env_info.clock_note: populated after the first successful run. The interruption time is measured across two clocks: the stop timestamp comes from the browser, the first tick timestamp from the target. offset from the fastest of 5 `date +%s%N` round trips, error smaller or equal rtt/2 + 1 ms (Cristian 1989). client_clock_skew_ms is the browser clock against the runner clock, from the fastest of 3 /clock round trips before the WebContainer boot; both run on the same host, the value documents that instead of assuming it. Per-run values are in results.csv.

env_drift.note: no earlier session with an env.json
